sources.source: Crime in England and Wales: year ending March 2026
sources.verified_fact: The official 23 July 2026 bulletin reports about 9.6 million CSEW headline-crime incidents and about 5.2 million police-recorded crimes excluding fraud and computer misuse; it also warns that recorded-crime trends are affected by recording practice and police activity.
sources.quality_effect: Promotes the previously scheduled release to a verified national context source, but does not replace May 2026 Police.uk local evidence or create parcel-level measurements.

sources.source: Crime in England and Wales: year ending March 2026 release landing page
sources.verified_fact: The release landing page still states that the release is not yet published even though the dated bulletin is available, demonstrating a publication-state lag between official pages.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a fail-closed ingestion rule: a landing-page flag alone cannot prove publication or non-publication; bulletin and dataset artifacts must be checked independently.

sources.source: Crime outcomes in England and Wales 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The 23 July 2026 official release covers investigative outcomes for offences recorded to March 2026 and provides data tables plus a technical annex; its bulletin reports 5,151 firearm offences, 98% linked to an outcome and a 12.9% charge or summons rate.
sources.quality_effect: Adds national investigative-outcome context while explicitly preventing outcome rates from being interpreted as local incidence, prevalence or parcel safety.

sources.verified_fact: The official rules page was updated on 16 July 2026 and defines the national standard for recording and counting notifiable offences; several 2026 document updates are listed.
sources.quality_effect: Upgrades the methodology guard so recorded-crime comparisons retain version and counting-rule provenance rather than assuming an invariant series.

sources.verified_fact: The live official availability endpoint lists 2026-05 as the latest street-level crime dataset month at the time of verification.
sources.quality_effect: Confirms that the existing May 2026 source month remains current; it does not prove count or SHA parity for the 16 canonical endpoints.

sources.verified_fact: The official archive lists a May 2026 snapshot of approximately 1.6 GB and states that older snapshots are archival while the latest month or custom download should normally be used.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a bulk-download fallback and archive-age guard; no large file was downloaded during this recovery-safe pass.

sources.verified_fact: The official method returns crimes within a one-mile radius or a custom area and states that locations are approximate rather than exact; large custom areas can return HTTP 503 and overly long GET requests can return HTTP 400.
sources.quality_effect: Revalidates the AREA_LEVEL_PROXY and bounded-request rules and prevents street-level output from being labelled as an exact parcel or incident location.
